additional_info.subject: ID0470612-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/TN4002937459] Charging Station not working CRM:03277000021
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex,
After today's site visit, it's clear that the problem is related to KF1.
The problem seems to be related to the fact that either there is a connection problem between KF1 and the other cartridges, or something in KF1 in the back part, since after Gazmend joined them with force, it stopped blinking red until he released it.
Even with a ziptie it's not enough so I believe there must be something wrong in the backpart which we couldn't access due to time constraints.
Please take to site a spare KF1, here are the MLFBs:
6ES7677-2DB40-0AA0 - Open Controller
6ES7193-6AR00-0AA0 - Bus adapter
Worst case scenario - 6ES7648-2BF10-0XM1 - CFAST card to be flashed
The CFAST card can be flashed with Companion, you just need to follow the instructions in the tool.
Next steps for the intervention to be performed:
Remove KF1 and all adjacent components
Check for any damaged pins or bus connectors
Insert it back if no damage is found, just to understand if it's a misconnection or similar
If it works then it must be that
If it doesn't work, let's try to replace the KF1
If replacing the KF1 doesn't work
Please try the new CFAST, if we can flash it before we go to site, it's much easier and faster than flashing the CFAST that is already on-site
I think that is everything, if you have any questions or doubts just reach out to me via Teams.
Thanks!
BR,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0470612-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/TN4002937459] Charging Station not working CRM:03277000021
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex,
I just went to my charger and I think we might have an easier method, as you can see between KF1 and KF2 there is this bus connector (white grey):
And this might be the connector that is faulty and causing these issues, next time we are on site, we can remove this one and attach it again and see if it's resolved or replace it.
Here is the MLFB: 6ES7193-6BP00-0DA0
Thanks!
BR,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0470612-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/TN4002937459] Charging Station not working CRM:03277000021
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex, good morning.
After yesterday's ExpertNow, the charger is fully operational, without a converter, which god knows why it failed.
What we did was, remove all the KF1 and reinsert it back. Definitely seems like there was some kind of loose connection to the back PCB, my suspicion was that the connection was hanging by a thread and when we open the door and create vibration/move the charger, it went into error again.
It was not necessary to replace anything.
Regarding the converter, we did several tests which included with DebugStation and we can see that the Output voltage is not raising, this means that even though we are supplying to the converter, it is not able to work.
We can confirm this because we checked all the DC and AC cables of the converter and even swapped this TB9 with TB7 (if i'm not mistaken) and the problem still persists in TB9, so this means that there is no cabling issue and the converter is faulty.
Since this ticket is about the KF1 problem, I will close it and if you need to replace the converter please open a new ticket and refer this ticket number ID0470612, so that I can give you the recommendation.
I will write the report and add it here, and close the ticket.
Thanks!
BR,
Francisco
